Loads when you dictate or select Download & load.
Choose when text appears and how much processing happens before insertion.
Used in Finish, then insert mode. Downloads a separate Gemma 270M model only when needed.
Used by models that accept language hints. Single-language models use their own language.
Notify when direct Accessibility insertion uses clipboard paste.
Insert the last transcript into the focused app.

Save future history audio for playback and transcription again.
Only needed for gated models. Stored in macOS Keychain; sent only to Hugging Face model downloads.
Authenticated loopback access. Connection details stay in project .aurascribe/control.
Activate the app where dictation started before inserting.
One name or technical term per line. Used by Parakeet GGUF vocabulary biasing and Whisper GGUF context prompts; other backends do not claim decoder biasing.
This is text replacement after recognition. It does not bias the speech decoder or change words already inserted during live typing.
Verified downloads. Metal when available: Downloads are checksum-verified. Only the selected model downloads. Metal is preferred; the model stays ready between clips and releases after inactivity.
Use the same short PCM WAV file to compare models on this Mac. No reference transcript means no accuracy score. Process memory excludes separate inference workers.
Inspect local state and preview the dictation indicator without opening the microphone. Pipeline preview runs the same saved steps used for dictation.
Click a destination text field during the countdown. Uses the test text below, or a short sample phrase. No microphone or model is used.
Record local and remote participants into separate project-local WAV tracks. System audio requires Screen & System Audio Recording access.
Name calls from the visible tab of the browser using the microphone. Uses Accessibility; falls back to the app name.
If Accessibility cannot read the tab, ask the browser through macOS Automation. macOS may request permission on the first detected call.
Reduce noise before calls. Preview with: Use macOS voice processing, automatic gain and a noise gate before sending audio to AuraScribe Microphone. Select that microphone in your calling app. Preview works without the driver; use headphones.
Choose a model, allow access, then try d: Choose a speech model, grant microphone and Accessibility access, then try your first dictation. Models download on first use and run on this Mac.
Anonymous speakers. Downloads models on: Downloads segmentation and speaker embedding models into this project when used. Speaker numbers are anonymous, not identities.
Capture a region, mark it up and add written or dictated notes. Screenshots, drawings and OCR stay in this project.
Keep 15 seconds of screen video. No audi: Continuously capture the main screen locally while enabled. Saves the latest 15 seconds, without audio.
